tiers.read: look only: read state, logs and gate output
tiers.wait: wait for a resource or a retry delay
tiers.retry: re-run a step Talos or CI already ran
tiers.restore: back up and restore known generated files in a workspace
tiers.handoff: hand the issue to Odysseus or resolve a conflict through it
tiers.engine: start or restart the Docker engine
tiers.free: stop the test containers of idle issues to free Docker memory
tiers.update: bring a PR branch up to date with its base or push a resolved merge (visible on GitHub)
tiers.resolve: resolve a merge conflict whose hunks are all additive, test it and push it (visible on GitHub)
tiers.merge: merge a PR through the merge gate (visible on GitHub)
tiers.file: file a Bug for a CI failure that is already on the base branch (visible in the tracker)

test_contention.does: wait for a free test slot, then retry

ci_failed.does: read ci-log and base-ci, then tell the cause apart. Temporary (timeouts, network, registry or GitHub 5xx, rate limits): rerun-ci within the 3 re-run attempts per PR head. Fails on the base branch too: file-bug (or link the open one), then hold-until-done on that bug. Caused by the PR's diff: send the issue to Odysseus with the failing test and a log excerpt

merge_conflict.does: back up the workspace, then resolve the conflict when every hunk is additive (resolve-conflict); otherwise send the issue to Odysseus with notes. CodeRabbit's auto review is off, so every commit an agent pushes needs a trigger from the shared daily budget (tiers: every PR, then large PRs and re-reviews, then a person only; ai rabbit budget). An update or a pushed resolution is a re-review; at the limit do not push, hand the issue to the owner (in_review, 'merge conflict, CodeRabbit limit reached: please resolve and review by hand'). The owner's own GitHub activity is not counted.

dirty_generated.does: back up and restore the known generated files

docker_down.does: start the engine; restart only if it stays unresponsive and nothing else is running; then retry

docker_pressure.does: stop stale containers; if still short, hold-until-docker; then retry
